title: Module 5: Writing Learning Objectives (Bloom + ABCD)
description: Translate vague stakeholder wishes into testable performances using Bloom's revised taxonomy for cognitive level and Mager's ABCD format for performance specificity.

learning_objectives.statement: Use Bloom's revised taxonomy to name the cognitive demand of a planned learning task
Convert a goal into an ABCD-format objective with audience, behavior, condition, and degree
Audit objectives, assessments, and activities for constructive alignment

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
